disclaimer: Initial screening only — not an eligibility determination. Green Credits (GCP) and carbon credits (CCTS) are separate mechanisms.

programmes.name: Green Credit Programme
programmes.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
requirements: Registration on the Green Credit Programme portal
Plantation on land parcels identified/approved under the programme
Verification of tree survival per the notified methodology
Understanding that Green Credits are not carbon credits and cannot be used for CCTS compliance
notes: Tree plantation is a notified Green Credit activity, but the 2024 tree-plantation methodology targets identified degraded land parcels made available by state forest departments; applicability to private farmland must be confirmed with the administrator (ICFRE).
Green Credit Programme is a separate mechanism from CCTS.

references.title: MoEFCC — Green Credit Programme (notification and methodology)

programmes.name: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (offset mechanism)
programmes.authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power
requirements: Approved offset methodology applicable to the activity
Monitoring plan with measurements (e.g. DBH, survival) and leakage assessment
Verification by a BEE-accredited carbon verification agency
Registration with the registry under the scheme
notes: BEE lists agriculture and forestry among sectors covered by accredited carbon verification agencies under the offset mechanism; a project needs an approved methodology, baseline, additionality demonstration, monitoring and third-party verification before any Carbon Credit Certificate is issued.
CCTS is a separate mechanism from Green Credit Programme.

references.title: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme, 2023 (Ministry of Power notification)

programmes.name: State agroforestry / horticulture missions (incentives)
programmes.authority: State governments (e.g. Karnataka Krishi Aranya Protsaha Yojane)
requirements: Farmer registration with the state forest/horticulture department
notes: Several states pay per-surviving-tree incentives or subsidise saplings for farmers; conditions vary by state.

references.title: Karnataka Forest Department — Krishi Aranya Protsaha Yojane
